name: Feroe House — Head of School Residence

geometry.axis_evidence: Longest north wall has source bearing 10.105 degrees; long south run is 9.914 degrees. The 20.301-degree minimum-area rectangle is not the facade frame.
geometry.floor_status: Photo/DTM interpretation; north ground approximately 55.5–56.3m, south ground approximately 53.45m. Not a building floor survey.

material_review.status: Reviewed original-texture palette retained; v7 is an exact archive patch for verified frame, rear-reveal and low-roof glazing defects. Native review pending.
material_review.actual_materials: Cream smooth rendered-looking main walls; cream painted joinery; irregular coursed gray/brown exposed stone; gray overlapping hip-roof units; white-painted deck railing. Species and proprietary products unverified.

proxy_assignments.cream_render: smooth_quartz: low-frequency warm pale original texture; does not imply real quartz walls
proxy_assignments.painted_panel_joinery: quartz_block, quartz_pillar, smooth_quartz_stairs/slabs: geometric paint/joinery proxies
proxy_assignments.rough_gray_brown_base: tuff_bricks: coherent muted coursed masonry texture, no claim of tuff geology
proxy_assignments.gray_shingle_roof: stone_brick stairs/slabs: original medium-gray overlapping-unit proxy, no claim of a stone-brick roof
proxy_assignments.thin_pale_rail_members: iron_bars with quartz newels and cap slabs; original textures only
proxy_assignments.slender_bay_columns: pale_oak_fence: restrained pale timber-geometry proxy for the photographed painted columns; exact substrate unknown

material_review.caution: Photo RGB includes unknown exposure, illumination and white balance; raw DeltaE is diagnostic rather than reflectance matching.

roof_evidence.authored_rule: Retain exact original footprint and accepted source surfaces outside a bounded west pediment. Replace only audited high fragments with an adjacent accepted plane. Low patches 4 and 11 are exposed deck/terrace interpretations. All authored surfaces are recorded separately.

chimneys.status: Pale shaft observed; exact plan position and height interpreted
Pale shaft observed on right roof; exact plan position and height interpreted

evidence.supports: Partly screened west elevation, cream smooth main walls, two-storey panel bay, paired sashes, pilasters, dentils, oculus and pediment, stone base, white raised deck, gray hip roof and two pale chimneys.
Official campus identity and residence position; no invented repositioning.
Interior photo resolves broad multi-light window and glazed-door joinery; does not independently identify a compass elevation.

uncertainties: Only the west elevation has an independently usable exterior photograph; trees screen its left bay and entrance. Two clearly visible paired groups per tier are observed; the third group behind trees is interpreted.
North/east/south opening counts and exact locations, north entrance and deck door are explicit construction interpretations awaiting additional photographs.
Smooth cream appearance is supported; render, paint, stone species and roof product are not specified. Minecraft block names describe proxies only.
Chimney count is photographed; exact shaft plan locations/heights are interpreted and not assigned to the rejected high fragments.

The 56.75m main floor, terrace, raised deck and three entrance steps are photo/terrain interpretations at half-metre voxel resolution; the roof raster also uses quarter-metre stair/slab surface positions.
Dentils, sash bars and panel relief are quantised at two blocks/metre. Native screenshots must still verify silhouette, glass support, apparent palette and terrain contact.
native_revision_notes: The v3 west reference and bay close-up passed root review with recorded 2x simplifications. The new pane-joint audit then found four open diagonal pairs on the interpreted south/deck elevations. V4 adds one authorised inward corner pane per pair and reconnects adjacent panes, preserving the accepted materials and all other geometry.

V4 was rejected: only two joints remained closed and two extra masonry seats were added. V5 applies the four authorised corner returns after all adjoining windows and preserves the two originally empty seating cells. Strict full-state diff against v3 is required.

V5 closed the four joints, but a concurrent shared reveal change removed twelve earlier connector panes during full rebuilding. V6 derives directly from the hash-checked accepted v3 block archive, preserving every original state before the four returns and neighbour connections.

V7 preserves exact v6 roof, terrain, bay trim, doors and all4 oculus panes. It removes77 stray/above-roof pane cells (3 become their existing wall backing), adds34 bounded wall/corner panes, removes5 fully isolated caps, and adds9 full concealed quartz cap/jamb cells. Exact original-model wall slices catch and close2 leaks missed by pane counts: the west bay/north junction and a two-cell south jamb backing void.

pane_corner_repair.basis: Four diagonal pairs recorded by pane_joint_report in accepted feroe-v3-2x/pane-joint-audit.json. Exact endpoint/corner cells are within the source footprint.

accepted_baseline.rule: Restore exact v6 archive before the enumerated, geometry-verified frame repair; preserve reviewed west bay, 2x2 oculus, source footprint and every roof-role block.

frame_contact_repair.rule: Remove only recorded rear-reveal stubs/above-low-roof leaks, complete actual wall-skin apertures and bounded one-cell returns, and back the verified south jamb void. Original vanilla models verified all22 sash-height half-block slices; oculus shape candidate remains explicitly classified.
